mapper.select: SELECT id,dept_name AS deptName FROM dept ORDER BY id

SELECT COUNT(1) FROM ( SELECT d.id FROM dept d LEFT JOIN users u ON u.dept_id=d.id AND u.status=1 WHERE 1=1
AND d.dept_name LIKE '%${deptName}%'
GROUP BY d.id ) AS temp
